executor_conventions.M2-C2 composition: the DSN-* convention has no interface id, so APIs are composed directly under the component (A3 composition is a catalogued kind)
executor_conventions.M2-C3 deployment: DSN-DEP-* carries component_id only; environment_id and platform_id are deliberately absent because no environment or platform instance exists; hence no DEPLOYED_ON (M2.4)

where_mapping_ends: A1->A2 (the eight given arrows) is the last mapping. Everything below SD-LO / SD-CA in this case is design: the components, APIs and deployments are instances the executor created from a pattern, not instances found in an export.
